review_notes: I read the whole target file and searched the repo for repeated machinery. The integral-closedness block (lines 46–57) re-proves the general fact that chartAlg R F S is integrally closed. That fact is already proved in P2M/Sol/S_AlgebraicCurve_TwoChartIntegralModel_isIntegrallyClosed_chartAlg and exported as the theorem AlgebraicCurve.TwoChartIntegralModel.isIntegrallyClosed_chartAlg. Other Sol files already call that theorem; the same argument is also copied in the two exists_hom_isFinite_surjective files. The other Krull-dimension block (lines 76–84) is only superficially similar to the quotient-ring versions in the ModularCurve descent files, so I did not report it. I did not check whether adding the Thm_..._isIntegrallyClosed_chartAlg import to the target would create an import cycle. The theorem file imports only Mathlib, the Definitions file, P2M.Util and its own Sol file, so I think a cycle is unlikely. I could not compile anything.

findings.problem: The block re-proves, inline, that chartAlg R F {j} is integrally closed. It does this by building the algebra structure over Algebra.adjoin R {j}, the scalar tower, and Algebra.IsIntegral, then applying isIntegral_trans and mem_chartAlg_iff. The repo already has this as the general theorem AlgebraicCurve.TwoChartIntegralModel.isIntegrallyClosed_chartAlg R F S, with no extra hypotheses. Other files use it directly, for example the exists_valuationSubring_of_mem_minimalPrimes_chartAlgFin file. The same argument is also written out in the helper lemmas chartAlg_isIntegral_adjoin and mem_chartAlg_of_isIntegral. So the same nontrivial argument is repeated in several proofs.
findings.proposed_change: Add `import Theorems.Thm_AlgebraicCurve_TwoChartIntegralModel_isIntegrallyClosed_chartAlg` and replace lines 46–57 with `haveI hIC : IsIntegrallyClosed ↥(chartAlgFin R F j) := AlgebraicCurve.TwoChartIntegralModel.isIntegrallyClosed_chartAlg R F {j}`. This works because chartAlgFin R F j is an abbrev for chartAlg R F {j}, and the existing theorem takes no IsFractionRing hypothesis. The hfrac line can stay; the shortened proof no longer depends on it. If the reusable statement is wanted inside the Sol layer instead, the shared lemma is `IsIntegrallyClosed (chartAlg R F S)`. Its proof sketch: an element x of F integral over chartAlg is integral over adjoin R S by transitivity, because chartAlg is integral over adjoin R S, so x lies in chartAlg by mem_chartAlg_iff. Both this file and the other copies would then call that lemma.
findings.benefit: This removes about 12 lines of dense instance plumbing from the main proof, so the smoothness argument is easier to follow. The integral-closedness argument then lives in one place, and a change to chartAlg or mem_chartAlg_iff needs fixing only once. The file also becomes consistent with the other Sol files that already use the library theorem.
